"""RoboPaint episode record: all motions through the public robot client.
Plans, camera observations and proprioception are saved beside this script.
Run: python gen.py plan.json
"""
import sys,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def execute(plan):
    r=Robot(); before=r.status()
    run=OUT/plan['name'];run.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (run/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2))
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none'); start=o.group('tcp_pose',now=True)
    rows=[]; prev=start[:3]
    for w in plan.get('waypoints',[]):
        p=np.array(w[:3]); seconds=w[3] if len(w)>3 else max(.3,np.linalg.norm(p-prev)/.035)
        n=max(1,round(seconds/.05))
        for t in np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:]: rows.append([*(prev+(p-prev)*t),0,1,0,0])
        prev=p
    for i in range(0,len(rows),180):
        a=np.array(rows[i:i+180]);np.save(run/f'actions_{i:05}.npy',a)
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.05,cameras=plan.get('cameras',['practice_cam']),video='frames',video_fps=5,note=plan['name'])
        res.save(str(run/f'chunk_{i:05}'))
        print('CHUNK',i,'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True).tolist(),'stopped',res.stopped,'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
        if res.stopped or res.done: raise RuntimeError(res.meta)
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=plan.get('final_cameras',['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam']),depth=True)
    o.save(str(run/'final'))
    for c,v in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(v).save(run/(c+'.png'))
    print('STATUS',r.status(),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__': execute(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])))
